rows.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose choice for pleasing or entertaining someone.

example.english: They really know how to amuse people.
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 sik1 tam2 jan4 hoi1 sam1

rows.note: Use this for the broader idea of entertaining or occupying people pleasantly, especially in formal or written contexts.

example.english: This performance can amuse the audience.
example.traditional: 呢場表演可以娛樂觀眾。
example.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 biu2 jin2 ho2 ji5 jyu4 lok6 gun1 zung3

rows.note: Use this when the subject is being funny or clowning around, rather than explicitly making a particular person laugh.

example.english: They are really funny and amuse everyone.
example.jyutping: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 gaau2 siu3

rows.note: Use this when something causes a particular person to laugh.

example.english: Your jokes can amuse me all evening.
example.traditional: 你啲笑話搞到我笑咗成晚。
example.jyutping: nei5 di1 siu3 waa6 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 siu3 zo2 seng4 maan5
